context_requirements: Expression of voltage-gated sodium channel (Nav) subunits, particularly neuronal isoforms such as SCN1A/2A/3A/8A/9A/10A/11A
A cellular context in which sodium channel activity or excitability influences transcription (e.g., excitable cells)
Prolonged exposure sufficient to produce downstream transcriptional changes, if any
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Enrichment of a specific transcriptional signature shared across multiple carboxamide antiepileptics in these lines
Changes in genes known to be regulated by sodium channel signaling (e.g., immediate early genes) that are not explained by generic stress
